decision_rule: Diagnostic R18-A only. The first rowflow unit is a source-, recipe-, and toolchain-bound successful single-TU CPU compile of ggml-base/gguf.cpp.o: the exact generated make rule returns 0, the target object is fresh, regular, ELF REL, and hash-recorded. This is not a symbol identity verdict. Full study completion requires both guarded CPU and gfx90a HIP builds to exit successfully and the unchanged compare_symbols.py to report zero added and removed symbols on CPU, HIP host, and gfx90a device versus the verified v10 anchor. The full-run terminal JSONL records pass, failed comparison, invalid comparison, or comparator not-run with provenance. Dry-run CPU-unit JSONL and each full-run terminal JSONL are filed under the row-specific result root in separate per-attempt directories; the rowflow glob counts either schema, while the completion predicate accepts only a matching full-run terminal bound to its full-result hash and comparator. Neither output overwrites packet full-result/comparator artifacts. No performance or production-promotion claim.
